question: Tuberculosis in 2023: how many people fell ill worldwide, how many died, and what share of treated people are cured? Answer with precise figures and cite your sources (title, year, URL).
answer:
In 2023 worldwide for tuberculosis:

* **Fell ill:** **10.8 million people** - including 6.0 million men, 3.6 million women and 1.3 million children.
* **Died:** **1.25 million people**, including 161,000 people with HIV.
* **Share of treated people cured / treatment success:** **88%** treatment success rate globally for drug-susceptible TB - 2022 treatment cohort reported in 2024.

Sources:
1. Title: Global tuberculosis report 2024, Year: 2024, URL: https://www.who.int/teams/global-tuberculosis-programme/tb-reports/global-tuberculosis-report-2024
2. Title: Tuberculosis - WHO Fact Sheet, Year: 2024, URL: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/tuberculosis
